versions.content: Service Name EthSwt_GetPortMacAddr Syntax Std_ReturnType EthSwt_GetPortMacAddr ( uint8 SwitchIdx, const uint8 * MacAddrPtr, uint8 * PortIdxPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x09 Sync/Async Synchronous /Asynchronous 5 51 of 149  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 656: AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetSwitchDriver Specification of Ethernet Switch Driver AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Reentrancy Non Reentrant SwitchIdx Index of the switch within the context of the Ethernet Switch Driver Parameters (in) MacAddrPtr MAC-address for which a switch port is searched over which the node with this MAC-address can be reached. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) PortIdxPtr Pointer to the port index Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: success E_NOT_OK: multiple ports were found Description Obtains the port over which this MAC-address at the indexed switch can be reached. The result might be used for a DHCP-server which will need the port/MAC-resolution. If for the PortIdxPtr the maximal possible value (255) is returned the given MAC address cannot be reached via a port of this switch. If multiple ports were found the API returns E_NOT_OK. Available via EthSwt.h
